definitions.gloss: the top leadership; the senior management team
definitions.explanation: The group of people at the very top of an organization, taken as a body: a company's executives, a party's leaders, or a team's coaching staff. Used when the whole leadership acts together.

examples.japanese: {首脳陣|しゅのうじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首脳陣|しゅのうじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The company's senior management held an emergency meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{首脳陣|しゅのうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Under the new leadership, the company's direction changed considerably.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧ (a top leader) plus the collective suffix 〜⟦{陣|じん}→陣：30535_jin⟧. Because 〜⟦{陣|じん}→陣：30535_jin⟧ makes the word plural and collective, it cannot refer to one executive; for that, use ⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧ or a specific title.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首脳陣|しゅのうじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: for the leadership to change hands
- {首脳陣|しゅのうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧: the leadership's decision
- {首脳陣|しゅのうじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}わる→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧: to join the senior ranks
- ⟦{球団|きゅうだん}→球団：16190_kyuudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首脳陣|しゅのうじん}: a baseball team's front office and coaching staff

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経営陣|けいえいじん}→経営陣：20535_keieijin⟧: the management team — business only, emphasizes running the company
- ⟦{幹部|かんぶ}→幹部：06875_kanbu⟧: executives, senior officials — countable and usable of one person
